part: final-a days 6-10 (Sun Jan 24 - Thu Jan 28, 2027): Suzuka/Nagoya, Kyoto, Kobe, Osaka, flight Itami -> New Chitose and drive to Kutchan

issues.problem: On the hotel's own booking site the non-smoking twin is already 'キャンセル待ち' (waitlist only) on Jan 28, 29 and 30, and the smoking twin that is still free costs ¥12,000 / ¥10,500 / ¥12,800 per person a night (about ¥35,300 each for 3 nights, not ¥25,500).
issues.fix: Book the smoking twin now (2 rooms left, free cancellation) or put yourself on the non-smoking waitlist, and raise the hotel cost to about ¥35,000 per person; else pick another Kutchan hotel.

issues.item: Suzuka Circuit Challenger EV kart at 10:45
issues.problem: The kart does not run all day: it runs in one short window around midday (Jan 24, 2026: 12:10-13:20; Jan 25, 2026: 11:55-13:05) and the January 2027 times are published only on Dec 1, so a 10:45 ride is probably not possible.
issues.evidence: https://www.suzukacircuit.jp/park/attraction/challenger/ (calendar: 'next month published on the 1st at 0:00'); Google Calendar ICS 472oith02gdtbpm07kf943i544@group.calendar.google.com; tickets https://www.asoview.com/channel/ticket/rDhDyukHG2/ticket0000007351/
issues.fix: Plan the kart for about 12:00-13:15, walk the park and grandstand before it, and leave Suzuka about 13:30 (Shiroko 13:56 limited express → Kintetsu-Nagoya 14:37, museum about 15:00 still works). Buy on Asoview on Dec 1.

issues.item: Limousine bus to Itami 09:05 from OCAT
issues.problem: There is no 09:05 bus: from JR Namba (OCAT) buses leave 08:50 and 09:10 (Itami North 09:20 / 09:40), and from Namba-ekimae 08:40 and 09:00 (North 09:10 / 09:30); fare ¥730, about 30 min, not 50.
issues.fix: Take the 08:40 or 09:00 bus from Namba-ekimae (N1), or 08:50 from OCAT, and get off at the North terminal (JAL); change the alert '09:00' and the leg to match.

issues.item: Car pickup 13:20 and arrival in Kutchan 15:45
issues.problem: Landing 12:35, bags, counter in arrivals and a 9-min shuttle make a 13:20 start tight; the Shikotsu–Bifue Pass route is 109 km (1 h 26 in summer), so in snow 2 h-2 h 30 gives about 16:00-16:15, close to sunset (about 16:37).
issues.evidence: https://rent.toyota.co.jp/shop/detail.aspx?rCode=61201&eCode=002 (Nov-Mar 08:00-20:00, shuttle about 9 min, one-way OK); https://router.project-osrm.org route CTS Poplar → Kutchan 109 km
issues.fix: Set pickup to 13:40 and keep the rule: if you leave the shop after 13:45 or it snows, take Route 5 via Otaru; or take the 07:35 JAL flight (¥13,030) for a relaxed day.

issues.problem: The ticket with the roof deck is ¥1,200 in total for an adult (observation only ¥1,000), not ¥1,200 + ¥200; hours 9:00-23:00, timed web ticket needed.
issues.fix: Change the place info to '¥1,200 with the roof deck (timed ticket)' and the day cost to tower ¥1,200.

issues.problem: Pokémon Center Osaka closes at 20:00 and is now listed as LUCUA South Building 13F (ex-Daimaru Umeda); arriving at Grand Front at 19:00 leaves under 1 h.
issues.fix: Go to Pokémon Center/Nintendo first at about 18:50, then Grand Front (open to 21:00); rename the place to 'LUCUA South 13F'.

issues.item: Aoki's early trip to Fushimi Inari
issues.problem: The hotel is not on the Midosuji Line; leaving 06:05 gives arrival at Fushimi-Inari about 07:15 (Nagahoribashi 06:15 → Kitahama, Keihan), not 07:00.
issues.evidence: https://www.jorudan.co.jp/norikae/ (長堀橋 → 伏見稲荷, Mon 06:15 → 07:16, ¥670)
issues.fix: Change the leg to 'Sakaisuji Line Nagahoribashi → Kitahama, Keihan Main Line to Fushimi-Inari, 1 h 10' and the stop to 07:15; leave Inari by 08:15 for the 09:00 Kinkakuji gate.

issues.problem: The Kyoto Station place says 'You meet here for lunch at Kyoto Ramen Koji', but the day has lunch at Sanjo Meitengai at 11:45 and Kyoto Station at 13:45.
issues.fix: Remove the lunch sentence from the Kyoto Station place (or make it 'optional snack at Ramen Koji').

issues.problem: Izumi-Sunagawa is a small station and a taxi from the park back to it was not confirmed; the site says open 11:00-21:00 every day, the Instagram says closed Thursdays (Wednesday is fine on both).
issues.evidence: https://libertywalk.co.jp/jdm-park-lb-drive-in/ (11:00-21:00, 365 days, 泉南市信達岡中1185-1); https://www.jorudan.co.jp/norikae/ (Tennoji → Izumi-Sunagawa 49 min, ¥750)
issues.fix: Plan to walk the 1.7 km (about 22 min) back, or ask the shop to call a taxi; keep the phone call on Jan 26.

issues.item: Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba twin rooms and price (nights Jan 24-27)
issues.problem: The hotel has only 12 twins + 7 compact twins of 229 rooms, and the Jan 23-28 price could not be read (Google Hotels ignored the dates).
issues.evidence: https://dormy-hotels.com/dormyinn/hotels/premium_nanba/floor (room counts, laundry: washers auto-detergent, dryer ¥100/20 min); https://dormy-hotels.com/dormyinn/hotels/premium_nanba/service (free ramen 21:30-23:00)
issues.fix: Book the twin for Jan 23-28 now on the official site (lowest price guarantee) and write the real price into the plan.
